nizima.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to nizima LIVE.

variables.nizima.host: The computer nizima LIVE runs on

nizima.disconnected.description: Runs when the connection to nizima LIVE drops, for example because you closed it.

variables.nizima.host: The computer nizima LIVE runs on

nizima.modelChanged.description: Runs when you select another model in nizima LIVE (the one Cuebot's steps act on when they name no model).

fields.model: Only react to these models. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any.

variables.nizima.host: The computer nizima LIVE runs on
variables.modelId: nizima LIVE's number for that model

nizima.expression.description: Turns one of your model's expressions on or off, like a smile, blush or angry face.

fields.model: Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one; most people have only one.
fields.expression: The expression's name, as nizima LIVE shows it. Connect first to pick from the list.
fields.state: On, Off, or Toggle (the opposite of now).
fields.only: Tick to turn every other expression off first, so only this one shows.

variables.nizima.expressionOn: True when the expression is now on

nizima.clearExpressions.description: Turns all of the model's expressions off, back to its normal face.

fields.model: Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one.

nizima.motion.description: Plays one of your model's motions, like a wave or a bow.

fields.model: Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one.
fields.motion: The motion's name, as nizima LIVE shows it.

variables.nizima.motion: The name of the motion that played

nizima.stopMotion.description: Stops the motion the model is playing.

fields.model: Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one.

nizima.hotkey.description: Presses one of the hotkeys you set up for your model in nizima LIVE, so anything a hotkey can do, an action can do too.

fields.model: Which model on screen. Leave empty for the selected one.
fields.key: The hotkey written the way nizima LIVE shows it, for example F1 or Ctrl+A.

nizima.addItem.description: Puts an item from your nizima LIVE item list on screen, like a hat, a sign or a pet.

fields.item: The item's name, as in nizima LIVE's item list.
fields.model: Which model's window to add it to. Leave empty for the selected model.

variables.nizima.itemId: nizima LIVE's number for the new item

nizima.removeItem.description: Takes an item off the screen again. Every item with that name goes.

variables.nizima.removed: How many items were taken off

nizima.changeModel.description: Swaps your model for another one from nizima LIVE's model list, for example a different outfit.

fields.newModel: The model to change to, as in nizima LIVE's model list.
fields.model: Which model on screen to swap. Leave empty for the selected one.

nizima.effect.description: Turns one of your nizima LIVE effects on or off, like sparkles or a colour filter.

fields.effect: The effect's name, as in nizima LIVE's effect list.
fields.state: On, Off, or Toggle (the opposite of now).

variables.nizima.effectOn: True when the effect is now on
